scholarships.title: Indic AI Scholarship Program CAT 2026
scholarships.award_amount: Selected students will receive a 100% scholarship for CAT preparation.
scholarships.eligibility: Open to PAN-India students who are currently pursuing an undergraduate (UG) degree , particularly those in their third or final year. Students who are planning to pursue an MBA and wish to prepare for the CAT examination. Students with disabilities holding a valid UDID (Unique Disability ID) card . Note: Accessible learning materials are provided to visually impaired students across programmes. Program Details Course: CAT Exam preparation Duration: 8 Weeks Mode: Live online classes with structured preparation Examinations Covered: CAT examination Batch Flexibility: Students joining at different stages may be accommodated based on the availability of the relevant batches. Course Fee: INR 47,000 Preparation Partner: IMS Learning

scholarships.title: Alivus Life Sciences VIGYASA Scholarship Program 2025-26 For class 11 & 12 (Science)
scholarships.award_amount: Fixed Scholarship of up to INR 72,000
scholarships.eligibility: Open to students from partnered schools under the Vigyasa Project . Students must be currently studying in Class 11 or Class 12 (Science) . Annual parental income should not exceed INR 8 lakh from all sources . Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in their previous academic year. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or Alivus Life Sciences are not eligible to apply. Note: Preference to be given to girls, Persons with Disabilities (PwD), single-parent children, orphans. Students already receiving full financial assistance under other scholarships or government schemes are not eligible.

scholarships.title: Vidyadhan Mathura Scholarship for Women in STEM 2026
scholarships.award_amount: Scholarships of up to INR 75,000 per year
scholarships.eligibility: Open to female students who are residents of Mathura District, UP, pursuing STEM courses such as MBBS, Engineering, B.Sc., or other STEM programmes in Mathura District or outside the district across India. The scholarship is also open to female students who may not be domiciled in the Mathura district but are currently pursuing a STEM course at an institution located in the Mathura district. Applicant must have secured at least 70% marks in Class 12 (60% for students with disabilities). Must have secured admission to the first year of a degree/professional programme for the Academic Year 2026–27 . Must have either completed Class 12 from a school located in Mathura District or be currently studying at an institution located in Mathura District. Annual family income must be less than INR 3 lakh .

scholarships.title: Raman Kant Munjal Scholarships 2026-27
scholarships.eligibility: Open to students across India currently enrolled in the first year of BBA, BFIA, B.Com (H, E), Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS), Integrated Program in Management (IPM), B.A. (Economics), Bachelor in Business Studies (BBS), or any other finance-related degree course. Applicants must have secured at least 80% marks in Classes 10 and 12 (For PwD students, the minimum percentage required is 70% marks). The annual parental income of the applicant must not exceed INR 6 lakh from all sources. Open for Indian nationals only. The children of employees/contract employees of Hero FinCorp, Raman Kant Munjal Foundation, and Buddy4Study are ineligible to apply. Note: Preference shall be given to: Children of farmers, domestic workers, and economically disadvantaged families. Applicants belonging to Tier 3 and Tier 4 cities.

scholarships.title: Muskaan Scholarship Program 2.0 (2026-27)
scholarships.award_amount: Up to INR 12,000 and mentorship support
scholarships.eligibility: Students studying in Classes 9 to 12 from the following states of India are eligible to apply: Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Odisha, Tripura, Puducherry, Sikkim, Tamil Nadu, Telangana and West Bengal. Open to children of commercial drivers , including LMV/HMV drivers , children of mechanics, and students belonging to the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) category . Applicants must have secured 60% and above in their previous class. The total annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 8 lakh . Children of employees of Valvoline Cummins Private Ltd. (VCPL) and Buddy4Study are not eligible.

scholarships.title: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Transgender Scholarship 2026-27
scholarships.eligibility: Open to pan-India transgender students pursuing secondary, senior secondary, or undergraduate/postgraduate studies through any government/private open school or open university. A minimum score of 35% in Class 10 and/or Class 12 is required. The applicants' parental income from all sources must not exceed INR 10,00,000 per year . Candidates who are children of employees of Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited or Buddy4Study are ineligible.

scholarships.title: Concentrix Scholarship Program 2026-27
scholarships.award_amount: INR 65,000 per year for the duration of the course
scholarships.eligibility: Open to Pan-India female students currently enrolled in the first year of the MBBS program at a government medical college . Applicants must have successfully completed their Grade 12 board examination. The annual parental income of the applicant must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources. Children of employees of Buddy4Study or Concentrix Pvt Ltd are not eligible to apply for this scholarship. Note: Preference will be given to the following applicants: Single-parent or orphan children Children from Aspirational Districts Students with disabilities Scholarship eligibility criteria can be updated at the discretion of the scholarship provider.

scholarships.title: Aditya Birla Capital Scholarship 2026-27
scholarships.eligibility: Open exclusively to meritorious girl students currently enrolled in Classes 9 to 12, Polytechnic Diploma, undergraduate, or postgraduate courses at recognised government schools/colleges/institutions across India. Applicants must have achieved a minimum of 60% marks in their most recent academic year. The applicant's annual family income must not exceed INR 6 lakh . Children of employees of Aditya Birla Capital, its subsidiary/JV businesses, and Buddy4Study are not eligible to apply.
